answer: Edge-Weighted Adoption Ledger. Each new agent must be introduced by an existing agent whose connectivity graph forms a sparse atlas of trust regions; an edge's weight decays unless the introduced agent maintains diverse, non-overlapping transaction paths. Duplicate identities cluster around one introducer, collapsing edge weight below the mesa threshold needed for full participation. An attacker must therefore sustain many separate high-diversity paths per identity, costing real opal-equivalent routing work and continuous path maintenance across distinct regions.
